Enclosure and Structural Designer said about it: The module datasheet in PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64) lists dimensions 1722 by 1134 by 30 mm and weight 20.5 kg, matched by dimensions 1762 by 1134 by 30 mm and weight 21.5 kg in SolarPeak Pro 400 (E65), giving six-module footprint 11.7 square metres in the panel footprint calc (E69), about a parking space, against a 2.4 m by 1.8 m roof of 4.32 square metres, so the split shade with 2 Photovoltaic (PV, solar-electric panel) modules on the roof gantry plus 4 modules on a separate ground frame on own footings in that same split layout sketch (E70) carries no panel loads into sandwich panels and keeps the vent gap that holds the 203 watt conduction in Professional Manufacturer Factory Keep Warm Insulated PU Sandwich Panel (E32).
Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist said about it: I take up your six-module footprint from the six 400W panel footprint calc (E69) via the PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Perf (E64) module datasheet: six modules cover about a parking space against a small-bedroom roof, so the separate ground frame stands in the working yard and my attendant keeps crates, goats and children clear.
Solar Energy Systems Engineer said about it: I take up the module datasheet in PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64) that Enclosure and Structural Designer put on the board, which lists 1722 by 1134 millimetre and about 20.5 kilogram, confirming nine modules cover 17.6 square metres in the nine-module footprint calc (E84), about a parking space against a 4.32 square metre roof, so 2 modules stay on the roof gantry as sunshade plus 7 modules on a separate ground frame in the grown split-array sketch (E85).
Manager said about it: The chosen array grows from short yield to covering load, with daily yield 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day in the grown-array yield calc (E83) against daily load 13.2 kilowatt-hour per day in the steady plus staged pull-down estimate (E58) leaving margin 0.300 kilowatt-hour per day in the daily margin calc (E86), about one household daily use so everyday scale holds, and the roof contradiction is settled as two modules on roof gantry plus seven on separate ground frame for nine-module footprint 17.6 square metres in the nine-module footprint calc (E84) from module size in PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64).
Enclosure and Structural Designer said about it: Nine modules cover 17.6 square metres in the nine-module footprint calc (E84) from module size 1722 by 1134 mm in PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64), and 25 metre per second gust gives 375 Pa in the gust pressure calc (E88), which over that area lifts like 673 kg in the uplift calc (E90), heavier than the frame itself, so the ground frame gets four screw anchors plus the roof gantry keeps its vent gap with no loads into sandwich panels.
Solar Energy Systems Engineer said about it: I take up the module datasheet in PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64) that you put on the board, which lists 1722 by 1134 mm and about 20.5 kg, confirming nine modules cover 17.6 square metres in the nine-module footprint calc (E84), about a parking space against a 4.32 square metre roof, so 2 modules stay on the roof gantry as sunshade with vent gap plus 7 modules on a separate ground frame with zero shading 9am-3pm, equator-facing tilt equal latitude plus 10 degrees, and worst-month 5.0 Peak Sun Hours (PSH, hours at 1000 watt per square metre) in my assumed constraint.
Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer said about it: R134a (tetrafluoroethane, A1 non-flammable refrigerant) stays field-serviceable per R134a vs R290 Refrigerant: Key Differences & Replacements (E17) against the hot-climate penalty in A solar powered off-grid air conditioning system with natural refrigerant (E23), with Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling per electric power) about 1.4 at hot ambient, and I take up the PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64) you put on the board for the 2-module roof sunshade vent gap, which from refrigeration cuts roof plus shaded-condenser lift in hot-dry peaks.
Manager said about it: Grown total 1840 kilogram in the grown mass calc (E87) supersedes 1780 kilogram in the summed chamber mass budget (E66), giving 18.8 kilopascal in the grown pad pressure calc (E89) superseding 18.2 kilopascal in the pad pressure check (E68) and still below 150 kilopascal soil in Structural Design Calculation Sheet | PDF | Strength Of Materials | Precast Concrete (E62), with nine-module footprint 17.6 square metres in the nine-module footprint calc (E84) from module size in PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64) split as 2 on roof plus 7 on ground in the grown split-array sketch (E85) with wind uplift like 673 kilogram in the uplift calc (E90) held by screw anchors.
Enclosure and Structural Designer said about it: Chamber path is box to plinth to six pads, roof gantry path is two modules to gantry to box pads with vent gap, ground path is seven modules to ground frame to own footings in the split layout sketch (E70) and the grown split sketch (E85) from module size in the PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64).
